meta.title: DESIGN VERIFICATION TEST
meta.subtitle: Complete Assembly — Mainboard, MIBs, Bus Bar, Fuses, Connectors, Air Tubes, Wiring
meta.descriptor: Test Procedure for Electronics Release Qualification on FCAT Bench
meta.creator: Electronics Engineering

coverRows.label: Unit Under Test (UUT)
coverRows.value: Q-PAC Fan Controller — complete assembly (PN 1704165, REV3): enclosure, mainboard PCB, MIB boards, bus bar + fuses, connectors (CN3-CN5 and internal harnesses), pressure-transducer air tubes, wiring

coverRows.label: Test Bench
coverRows.value: Fan Controller Automated Tester (FCAT) — pressure generator + NI LabVIEW + SCPI

coverRows.label: Release Gate
coverRows.value: Section severity → required sections per Appendix B. Section A (external Main Board DVT) and Section B (external MIB DVT) must be signed off before this DVT begins.

coverRows.label: Sibling Documents
coverRows.value: Main Board DVT (PCB-level, see Section A); MIB DVT (see Section B); Q-PAC_MPF_DVT (system-level, treats Fan Controller as black box)

coverRows.label: Format
coverRows.value: Contents page (clickable TOC) immediately after cover. Sections A and B = external references. Sections C–J = table-based per-test rows. Tester records measurement in Measure column. Field refresh (Word: Ctrl+A → F9; LibreOffice: Tools → Update → Fields) updates page numbers and TOC P/F mirror. Elaborations in Appendix C. Equipment in Appendix A. Release-gate matrix in Appendix B.

knownIssues.heading: Known Issues — v1.2.0 Firmware
knownIssues.intro: Suite-side xfail entries and corresponding DVT step pass criteria. Each row remains until fix releases and XPASSes. New issues appended in same four-column shape.

externalRefs.title: Main Board DVT
externalRefs.intro: PCB-level qualification of the bare mainboard is owned by the external Main Board DVT. This document begins at the assembled-controller boundary; bare-board electrical functional, HiPot, ICT, AOI are not repeated here.
externalRefs.passCriteria: Signed Main Board DVT on record for the mainboard serial number installed in this Fan Controller assembly. Signed copy attached to this run as artifact. Section B does not begin until Section A artifact is present.

externalRefs.title: MIB DVT
externalRefs.intro: PCB-level qualification of each MIB board is owned by the external MIB DVT. MIB-board electrical functional, AOI, and SPI-side functional testing are owned by that document and not repeated here. This DVT begins MIB coverage at the assembled-controller / FCAT-fixture boundary in Section E.
externalRefs.passCriteria: Signed MIB DVT on record for every MIB serial number installed in this Fan Controller assembly. Signed copies attached to this run as artifacts. Section C does not begin until all MIB DVT artifacts are present.

appendixA.heading: Appendix A — Equipment
appendixA.intro: All test equipment, fixtures, and instrumentation referenced from test rows.

appendixB.heading: Appendix B — Release-Gate Matrix
appendixB.intro: Change severity mapping to required DVT sections. Straw-man — Engineering to refine with Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, System DVT owner. When in doubt, table requires section.

appendixC.heading: Appendix C — Elaborations and Rationale
appendixC.intro: Design rationale and known-issue mechanisms referenced by Brief column. Listed by table reference or topic.

steps.brief: Inspect enclosure, panels, harness routing, controller mounting with light and loupe.
steps.criteria: No visible damage; panel screws at torque; PCB on 4 screws; ties tight

steps.brief: Torque each bus bar lug with calibrated wrench; verify clearance per drawing. Top fire/arc-fault risk.
steps.criteria: All lugs at spec torque; clearance per drawing; no debris/corrosion

steps.brief: Verify fuse class, V, A match nameplate; no substitutions.
steps.criteria: All fuses match nameplate class/V/A

steps.brief: Tug-test CN3, CN4, CN5 and internal connectors. Visual latch check insufficient.
steps.criteria: All seated; latches engaged; tug-test holds

steps.brief: Inspect PT air tubes: routing, port mapping, fittings; optional leak test.
steps.criteria: Per drawing; no kinks; fittings tight; leak holds within transducer spec

steps.brief: Inspect routing, strain relief, labels; verify no bare conductors or crossed pairs. AI1+/AI1− swap is documented field failure.
steps.criteria: Per harness map; zero bare; reliefs engaged; labels match BoM

steps.brief: Megger L1/L2/L3/neutral/bus to chassis at 500 VDC for 60 s; signal cables disconnected.
steps.criteria: ≥100 MΩ each point

steps.brief: DMM bus-GND, AI1 and AO1 polarity, K1 rest state.
steps.criteria: Bus-GND >100 MΩ; pairs not crossed; K1 at rest

steps.brief: DMM 3.3 V, 12 V, 24 V, V_RECT at idle, CN3=24 VDC.
Read rail-monitor ADC via console; compare to DMM. Drifted monitor was implicated in a prior cold-start regression — guard against recurrence.
steps.criteria: Each monitor within ±2% of DMM

steps.brief: Sweep CN3 22–26 VAC and 22–26 VDC in 1 V steps, 30 s dwell; log rails.
steps.criteria: Rails within D.1.1; no trip, brownout, comm drop

steps.brief: Sweep CN3 24 VAC 50–60 Hz in 2 Hz steps; verify firmware-reported frequency.
steps.criteria: Within ±2% applied each step

steps.brief: Connect 3.3 V TTL UART; capture boot banner.
steps.criteria: Banner ≤2 s; IDN matches Test fw 2.0.0 string; zero framing/parity over 60 s

steps.brief: Issue rail, AI/AO setpoint, DAC, EEPROM commands; capture responses.
steps.criteria: All return expected; zero retries in 100-cmd sequence

steps.brief: Master 9600 8N1; read IDN and identity registers at default address.
steps.criteria: Identity reads; rev REV3; firmware match; zero frame/parity/CRC errors 5 min

steps.brief: Send "0123456789" via echo register; read back.
steps.criteria: Byte-identical; zero retries

steps.brief: Vary termination (absent, single-end, both-end 120 Ω); capture differential waveform.
steps.criteria: Rise/fall ≤ transceiver spec worst case; zero corrupted in 1000-frame burst

steps.brief: Drive AI1 with calibrated 5.00 V ±1%; read firmware value.
Drive AI1 with 3 random voltages in 1–10 V at 1% precision.
steps.criteria: All 3 within ±2% applied

steps.brief: Drive AI1 shorted to AI1− and disconnected; record reported.
steps.criteria: Short: 0.00 V ±2% FS; Float: in documented floating region, not commanded speed

steps.brief: Set A1_OUTPUT to 3 random V in 1–5 V; measure at 5 mV.
steps.criteria: All 3 within ±4% commanded

steps.brief: Step DAC ±200 mV around 4.00 V; verify comparator transitions. Drift causes misapplied-AO behavior.
steps.criteria: Deterministic transition; no chatter; 4.00 V ±2%

steps.brief: Toggle selector between source 1 (4 V) and source 2 (1 V); confirm DAC follows. Stuck selector is the in-circuit analog of the misapplied-AO failure mode.
steps.criteria: Pos 1: 4 V ±4%; Pos 2: 1 V ±4%; toggle latency in spec

steps.brief: Read feedback ADC while sweeping DAC; compare at 3 points from D.5.1.
steps.criteria: Feedback within ±4% commanded each point

steps.brief: Set AIRFLOW_OUTPUT to 3 random V in 1–10 V; measure at 5 mV.
steps.criteria: All 3 within ±4% commanded

steps.brief: Sweep each DI 0.0–3.3 V in 0.05 V steps; record transition.
steps.criteria: HIGH ≥3.00 V; LOW ≤0.1 V; hysteresis in spec

steps.brief: Command each DO HIGH/LOW; measure no-load and 10 kΩ.
steps.criteria: HIGH > (3.3 V − 300 mV) both loads; LOW <0.1 V both

steps.brief: Cycle K1 50× via console; DMM K1A/K1B/K1C.
steps.criteria: 50 cycles transfer correctly; no misses; bounce in debounce window

steps.brief: Apply 0.0–10.0 inWc in 2.5 steps with calibrated pressure generator, 30 s dwell. Guards v1.2.0 PT type detection and SPI integration regression.
steps.criteria: Within transducer spec each step; monotonic; PT type detection reports expected vendor

steps.brief: Hold 5.0 inWc; sample at 10 Hz for 5 min; compute mean, std dev.
steps.criteria: Std dev in transducer noise spec; mean within ±1% of 5.0

steps.brief: Mainboard flat; read 3 axes via console.
steps.criteria: Each axis 970–1030 mg

steps.brief: Tilt 90° about X then Y; re-read. v1.2.0 added board-rev-dependent CS selection.
steps.criteria: Values match expected ±1 g within tilt accuracy

steps.brief: Write "test" to EEPROM scratch; power-cycle; re-read.
steps.criteria: Scratch reads "test" exactly; zero bit errors over 100-write/read burst

steps.brief: Connect Ethernet on 192.168.0.0/24; ping default IP; capture ARP.
steps.criteria: Link LED active; ARP succeeds with documented MAC; ICMP 0% loss over 100 packets

steps.brief: Disconnect Ethernet mid-run, reconnect; verify recovery. v1.2.0 brings new PHY driver.
steps.criteria: Recovers ≤5 s; no reset; no Modbus alarm; no missed frames

steps.brief: Quick stack-init sanity via BAC0 Who-Is broadcast. Full BACnet coverage in Section F.
steps.criteria: I-Am received ≤5 s; device instance matches identity; no Modbus alarms/resets/poll impact

steps.brief: Run pytest -k "TestInputRegisters or TestHoldingRegisters" against UUT (slave 19).
steps.criteria: TestInputRegisters PASS (4/4); TestHoldingRegisters PASS (2/2); fw ver and slave ID match

steps.brief: Run pytest -k "TestSlaveIdChange"; exercises the documented writing-key lockout gating slave-ID write.
steps.criteria: TestSlaveIdChange PASS (1/1); controller restored

steps.brief: Run pytest -k "test_temperature_plausible"; record reported temp.
steps.criteria: PASS; temp within ambient + margin

steps.brief: Run pytest -k "test_speed_mod_input_mode_write or test_speed_mod_percentage_write". In-firmware analog of the misapplied-AO failure mode.
steps.criteria: All TestHoldingRegisterWriteReadBack PASS; originals restored

steps.brief: Run pytest -k "test_constant_airflow_setpoint_write"; HR 6 round-trip (500, 0, restore).
steps.criteria: Both setpoint round-trip tests PASS

steps.brief: Run pytest -k "TestInputRegisters or TestDiscreteInputs or TestHoldingRegisters or TestCoils". Reads all 19 IRs, 10 DIs, 7 HRs, 9 coils.
steps.criteria: All 4 classes PASS; zero exceptions on valid addresses

steps.brief: Run pytest -k "TestErrorCases or test_alarm_code_at_110_percent or test_alarm_clears_at_0_and_100". OOB reads return exception; invalid writes raise ALARM_CODE 7.
steps.criteria: TestErrorCases PASS (3/3); alarm_code_at_110_percent PASS; alarm_clears PASS

steps.brief: Run pytest -k "TestOutOfBoundsValidation". XFAIL on v1.2.0 per known_issues.cfg until write-side rejection ships.
steps.criteria: PASS (2/2) OR XFAIL per cfg; D.14.2 must still PASS

steps.brief: Run pytest -k "test_alarm_clears_at_0_and_100"; cross-reference priority (Fatal=1 > Error=2 > Warning=7).
steps.criteria: Transitions match priority; zero code-7 hold over active 2 or 1

steps.brief: Mount all MIBs per UUT BoM; command token-shift enumeration; capture tokens.
steps.criteria: Enumeration ≤ fw spec time; every slot returns token matching label; no phantom slots

steps.brief: Force token-shift inactive on a single slot; re-attempt enumeration.
steps.criteria: Enumeration fails or that MIB reads absent; firmware does not assign position

steps.brief: Command MIB fan-enable ON/OFF; DMM no-load and test load.
steps.criteria: ON ≥ MIB spec under load; OFF < LOW threshold both

steps.brief: Inject open and short-to-ground on fan-status return; confirm MOTOR STATUS transitions.
steps.criteria: Open → fault; Short → fault with sub-code; Healthy → 0

steps.brief: Sweep SPI 100–640 kHz in 60 kHz steps; 1000-frame burst; capture eye.
steps.criteria: Zero bit errors each rate; clean eye at 640 kHz; setup/hold in spec

steps.brief: Repeat E.3.1 with 3.3 V at low-end tolerance.
steps.criteria: Zero bit errors each rate at 3.3 V = 3.1 V

steps.brief: Continuous SPI traffic at production rate for 10 min with all configured MIBs polling; capture eye at center and bracket extremes.
steps.criteria: Clean eye at all 3 points; zero corrupted frames over 10 min

steps.brief: Apply 0.0–10.0 inWc in 2.5 steps to MIB PT port; read via mainboard.
steps.criteria: Within transducer spec; monotonic

steps.brief: Repeat E.4.1 with each approved vendor in MIB BoM; compare vendor-to-vendor.
steps.criteria: Vendor agreement in cross-vendor tolerance every point; no vendor non-monotonic

steps.brief: Deferred — no programmable load on bench. Verify unloaded zero-current matches MCU telemetry; loaded shifts to MPF DVT.
steps.criteria: Unloaded zero current; no spurious fault; loaded marked deferred-to-system-DVT

steps.brief: Start BAC0 instance on test PC; broadcast Who-Is; capture I-Am from UUT. Minimal connectivity sanity — applies to Rev 3 v1.2.0 (partial BACnet) and Rev 4+ (full BACnet).
steps.criteria: I-Am received ≤5 s with documented device instance, BACnet address, vendor ID; no Modbus impact during broadcast

steps.brief: BAC0 reads device-name, vendor-identifier, model-name, firmware-revision, application-software-version. Rev 4+ only — XFAIL on Rev 3 v1.2.0 (object read not yet implemented).
steps.criteria: All 5 objects return values matching identity sources (Modbus IRs, silkscreen); Rev 3 v1.2.0 marked XFAIL per known_issues

steps.header: BAC0 read AI1 voltage and airflow
steps.brief: BAC0 reads AI:0 (AI1 hardwired 0–10 V) and AV:1 (MPF Total Airflow, CFM) at 1 Hz for 60 s; cross-reference Modbus QFAN_AI1 and IR 8 (QFAN_AIRFLOW). Rev 4+ only.
steps.criteria: AI:0 agrees with Modbus QFAN_AI1 within ±1%; AV:1 agrees with Modbus IR 8 within ±1% after unit conversion; zero exceptions; no Modbus poll impact

steps.brief: BAC0 writes AO:1 (MPF Speed Control, R/W) to 3 values in 0–10 V range with MI:0 (Control Source) = 2 (BACnet); verify Modbus mirror and physical UUT AO1 voltage. Rev 4+ only.
steps.criteria: All 3 writes confirmed; AO:1 readback within ±0.05 V; Modbus mirror within ±1%; UUT AO1 DMM within ±4% commanded

steps.brief: BAC0 reads BI:0 (K1A), BI:1 (K1B), BI:2 (Start/Stop), and BV objects (Run Status, Fan Motor n Blank-Off, Fan Motor n Fault, Fan Motor n Enabled). Cross-reference Modbus DIs and coils. Rev 4+ only.
steps.criteria: Every BI and BV matches corresponding Modbus DI/coil bit-for-bit; no spurious objects

steps.brief: BAC0 reads MI:0 (Control Source), MO:0 (Fan Status), MV:0 (Motor Count), MV:1 (Motors Enabled), MV:2 (Power State). Rev 4+ only.
steps.criteria: Each multistate value matches firmware console; MV:2 reports Normal under nominal CN3

steps.brief: BAC0 subscribes to AI:0 with COV increment; force voltage change at AI1 input; verify COV notification. Rev 4+ only.
steps.criteria: COV notification received ≤5 s of change; reported value matches stimulus within ±1%; unsubscribe clean

steps.brief: Run BAC0 reads at 1 Hz concurrent with Modbus polling at 1 s for 30 min; both interfaces active. Rev 4+ only.
steps.criteria: Both interfaces serve continuously; zero exceptions/timeouts; rails within D.1.1; no alarms; UUT not reset

steps.brief: Launch YABE on test PC; perform Who-Is; click UUT device; expand object list. Cross-reference enumerated objects against published points list (Confluence).
steps.criteria: All published objects present (AI:0; AO:0, AO:1; AV:0, AV:1; BI:0–2; BO:0, BO:1; BV:0 plus motor blank-off/fault/enabled; MI:0; MO:0; MV:0–2); no unpublished objects; on Rev 3 v1.2.0 only device-identification visible

steps.brief: Apply 5.00 V to AI1 input. In YABE, read AI:0 present-value.
steps.criteria: AI:0 reads 5.00 V ±2%; cross-check Modbus QFAN_AI1; YABE refreshes within 1 s. Rev 4+ only.

steps.header: YABE switch Control Source to BACnet
steps.brief: In YABE, write MI:0 (Control Source) = 2 (BACnet). Confirm write succeeds.
steps.criteria: MI:0 readback = 2; firmware console confirms control source = BACnet; Modbus mirror updates. Rev 4+ only.

steps.brief: With Control Source = BACnet (per F.6.3), write AO:1 (MPF Speed Control) to 7.50 V via YABE. Measure UUT AO1 with DMM; observe AV:1 (MPF Total Airflow).
steps.criteria: AO:1 readback = 7.50 V ±0.05; UUT AO1 DMM = 7.50 V ±4%; AV:1 matches Modbus IR 8 within ±1%. Rev 4+ only.

steps.brief: With DI1 closed (Start), in YABE write BV:0 (Start/Stop) = FALSE. Observe Run Status and motor behavior. Restore BV:0 = TRUE.
steps.criteria: Motors stop on BV:0=FALSE; Run Status BV reflects; motors restart on BV:0=TRUE; matches BACnet override documentation. Rev 4+ only.

steps.brief: In YABE, write Fan Motor 1 Blank-Off BV = TRUE. Observe MV:0 (Motor Count), MO:0 (Fan Status), Fan Motor 1 Fault BV, and alarm relay (BI:0/BI:1). Restore Blank-Off = FALSE.
steps.criteria: MV:0 decrements by 1; Fan Motor 1 Fault does NOT raise alarm (blank-off suppresses per documented behavior); BI:0/BI:1 do not transition; restore returns MV:0 and Fault state. Rev 4+ only.

steps.brief: Trigger an alarm (disconnect a non-blanked motor). In YABE read BI:0 (K1A) and BI:1 (K1B); also MV:2 (Power State). Cross-check physical K1 contacts and Modbus alarm code.
steps.criteria: BI:0 (K1A) TRUE on fault (NC open); BI:1 (K1B) TRUE on fault (NO closed); MV:2 stays Normal unless brownout; physical K1 transitions; Modbus ALARM_CODE matches. Rev 4+ only.

steps.brief: Reference PLC BACnet PICS PDF (Confluence). Spot-check 3 declared services via YABE: ReadPropertyMultiple, WritePropertyMultiple, COV-Notification. Confirm undeclared services return NotSupported.
steps.criteria: All 3 declared services respond per PICS; one undeclared service returns NotSupported. Rev 4+ only.

steps.brief: Instrument 3.3/5/12/24 V rails and MCU NRST on scope at nominal CN3.
steps.criteria: All 4 ch at steady nominal; reset de-asserted; scope triggers reliably on rail-collapse threshold

steps.brief: Idle controller; CN3 OFF; record times to 3.3 V@80%, 50%, MCU reset assert, all rails zero.
steps.criteria: All 4 times recorded; reset asserts before any rail < MCU brownout threshold

steps.brief: Repeat G.0.2 with Modbus polling at 1 s production rate.
steps.criteria: Loaded times ≥ idle times by non-zero margin

steps.brief: Repeat G.0.2 at max-supported N (9 MIBs), motors unloaded. Loaded portion deferred — no programmable load on bench.
steps.criteria: All 4 times recorded at max-N unloaded; reset still leads any rail below threshold; loaded cell marked DEFERRED

steps.brief: CN3 ON from cold; capture rise; record CN3-ON to 3.3 V@90%, MCU reset de-assert, firmware banner.
steps.criteria: Three rise times; sequencing per firmware turn-on order; no overshoot; zero spurious console pre-banner

steps.brief: Compute G.1–G.4 dwell from measurements (G.1=5×reset, G.2=1×zero, G.3=0.5×zero, G.4=0.1×zero). Re-derive on layout change.
steps.criteria: Four dwell values derived from real measurements before any sweep

steps.brief: 50 cycles at G.1 dwell (long, full collapse); ON dwell 60 s; verify banner, identity reads, atmospheric PT each cycle.
steps.criteria: All 50 boot clean; all 50 PT atmospheric; zero errors

steps.brief: 50 cycles at G.2 dwell (rails just reach zero); same per-cycle checks as G.1.1.
steps.criteria: All 50 boot clean; PT atmospheric; zero errors

steps.brief: 50 cycles at G.3 dwell (half-discharge, brownout window where prior regression lived); scope 1-in-5.
steps.criteria: All 50 boot clean; PT atmospheric; captures show no out-of-spec rail/reset; no out-of-range PT in first 1 s

steps.brief: 50 cycles at G.4 dwell (10% discharge, rails mostly energized); scope every 5th. Any deviation triggers CAR and blocks release.
steps.criteria: All 50 boot clean; zero out-of-range PT in first 1 s; zero errors

steps.brief: Master polls at 1 s during 20 G.3-class cycles; verify clean disconnect/reconnect.
steps.criteria: Clean disconnect/reconnect each cycle; zero garbled frames ±2 s of transition; zero stale-data accepts; ALARM_CODE 7 not triggered

steps.brief: Run pytest -k "TestBlackoutDetection" alongside cycles. Expects ALARM_CODE 1 on >30% sag below 16.8 V. XFAIL on v1.2.0 until detector ships.
steps.criteria: PASS (4/4) with detector enabled OR XFAIL per cfg; XPASS treated as anomaly

steps.brief: Run run_modbus_tests.py with N spanning ≥24 h; instrument rails and ambient on DAQ at 1 sample/s.
steps.criteria: Runner reports estimated total runtime; DAQ writing; test record init with UUT ID, fw ver, suite SHA, cfg rev

steps.brief: Set Modbus master timeout to firmware-under-test value. v1.2.0 requires PLC 4.4.0-equivalent timeout, not legacy.
steps.criteria: Timeout per compat table, recorded on the data sheet; mismatch invalidates run

steps.brief: Soak runs uninterrupted to N or 24 h; do not interact; writes per-iter HTML/XML and summary.txt.
steps.criteria: Completes; summary.txt zero FAILs (XFAIL/XPASS allowed, each XPASS recorded); rails within D.1; bounded temp drift; zero trips

steps.brief: Read CONTROLLER_INTERNAL_TEMPERATURE (IR 18), EEPROM scratch ("test" from D.11.1), reset counter.
steps.criteria: Temp within enclosure-warm bound; scratch reads "test"; reset counter unchanged or reconciled

steps.brief: Aggregate JUnit XML: PASS/XFAIL/XPASS/FAIL totals, per-test failure rate, max and 99th-pct wall time.
steps.criteria: Zero unexpected FAILs; XPASS reconciled vs cfg; per-test p99 in fw spec; per-iter pass rate ≥99.5%

steps.brief: Attach summary.txt, first/last iteration HTML, any FAIL iter, rail/temp CSV.
steps.criteria: Artifacts attached; reviewer can recompute H.3.1

steps.brief: During MPF DVT §5.2 (AI1=10 V, 5 min); compare AIRFLOW_OUTPUT DMM, QFAN_AIRFLOW (IR 8), per-fan IR 9-17, anemometer.
steps.criteria: AIRFLOW_OUTPUT and QFAN_AIRFLOW agree within ±1%; per-fan sums to total within rounding; all agree with anemometer within ±10%

steps.brief: After MPF DVT §6.2 (motor #3 off), also disconnect motor #1; read all MOTOR STATUS, ALARM STATUS, ALARM CODE.
steps.criteria: 1 and 3 fault; 2 and 4 healthy; ALARM STATUS=1; ALARM CODE=2; ACTIVE_MOTOR_QUANTITY reflects loss

steps.brief: Run Premium Panel scenarios #1, #2, #6, #13, #14 targeting documented failure modes. Requires PLC 4.4.0 per v1.2.0 release notes.
steps.criteria: Each scenario produces expected Fan Controller behavior per scenario pass criteria

steps.brief: For each (mainboard rev, firmware version) targeted for support, run Section D against representative unit.
steps.criteria: All targeted pairs pass Section D; failing pairs added to Block list in Section J back-compat matrix

steps.brief: Load previous-release firmware on UUT, run D + G.0; reload release candidate, re-run.
steps.criteria: Downgrade succeeds; D passes on prior; upgrade succeeds; D passes again; EEPROM preserved

steps.brief: Diff test_modbus_map.py commit between prior-release sign-off and release candidate. Each change = contract change.
steps.criteria: Diff captured; every test add/assertion change reconciled with user-manual and release notes; removed tests carry rationale

steps.brief: Run previous-release suite commit against release-candidate firmware.
steps.criteria: Previous suite passes in full OR each failure documented as intentional change with corresponding RC suite update

sections.name: Mechanical / Pre-energize Checks
sections.title: Section C — Mechanical / Pre-energize Checks
sections.intro: Run de-energized before mounting in FCAT. Catches assembled-unit defects that destroy hardware, injure personnel, or invalidate downstream measurements at first power-up. Mainboard PCB and MIB boards already qualified per Section A and Section B external references.

sections.name: Mainboard FCAT Tests
sections.title: Section D — Mainboard FCAT Tests
sections.intro: Exercise every documented interface on assembled controller with UUT in FCAT fixture, no MIBs attached. Tolerances trace to 1704165 Rev3 product specifications. Re-verifies at assembled-unit boundary what the Main Board DVT verified at bare-board boundary.

sections.name: MIB-Side Behavior
sections.title: Section E — MIB-Side Behavior
sections.intro: Exercise MIBs as installed in UUT (fixed N per BoM). [mib.3.3] sustained SPI eye replaces former multi-N integration coverage; loaded current-sense ([mib.5.1]) defers to MPF DVT until programmable load is on bench. PCB-level MIB qualification owned by external MIB DVT (Section B).

sections.name: BACnet (BAC0 + YABE)
sections.title: Section F — BACnet (BAC0 + YABE)
sections.intro: Functional BACnet checks. [bacnet.1]–[bacnet.5] = automated via BAC0 (Python BACnet client, https://bac0.readthedocs.io/). [bacnet.6] = manual interactive via YABE (Yet Another BACnet Explorer). Object IDs reference our published BACnet points list — see <Confluence Link>. [bacnet.1.1] and [bacnet.6.1] Who-Is sanity applies to Rev 3 v1.2.0 partial BACnet; [bacnet.1.2]–[bacnet.5.1] and [bacnet.6.2]–[bacnet.6.8] are Rev 4+ which ships full BACnet stack. On Rev 3 v1.2.0, Rev 4+ rows are expected XFAIL per known_issues.cfg.

sections.name: Power-Cycle Robustness
sections.title: Section G — Power-Cycle Robustness
sections.intro: Empirical brownout characterization in [pwrcycle.0] feeds dwell parameters for [pwrcycle.1]–[pwrcycle.4]. MPF DVT does not exercise variable-length cycles — this section is the only place at any level that does.

sections.name: 24 h Soak Under Modbus Polling
sections.title: Section H — 24 h Soak Under Modbus Polling
sections.intro: Regression guard for Modbus timing defects that only surface after sustained polling. Catches drift-class defects single-shot tests miss.

sections.name: Integration Cross-Checks
sections.title: Section I — Integration Cross-Checks
sections.intro: Cross-checks with MPF DVT under load. Run only after Section [mech]–[soak] pass on bench and MPF DVT §3–§5 pass on system.

sections.name: Backward-Compatibility
sections.title: Section J — Backward-Compatibility
sections.intro: Qualify UUT firmware-and-mainboard against population of MIB revisions and firmware versions in field.

knownIssues.defect: Blank-off coil ON does not suppress that fan's alarm; fan alarm reads True (inverted).
knownIssues.dvt: D.14.1 (Coils + DI subset). XFAIL accepted; XPASS = fix landed.

knownIssues.defect: Blackout detection not yet shipped — detector function not yet implemented in firmware.
knownIssues.dvt: G.5.2. Pass accepts suite PASS or XFAIL-per-cfg.

knownIssues.defect: Write-side input validation incomplete for some HRs; OOB write rejection not yet shipped.
knownIssues.dvt: D.14.3. D.14.2 (ALARM_CODE=7 on invalid write) still PASSes.

knownIssues.defect: Fan Controller → PLC Modbus RTU needs higher response timeout; requires PLC 4.4.0.
knownIssues.suite: Soak runner timeout configured to v1.2.0 spec.
knownIssues.dvt: H.1.1 / H.1.2 timeout config; I.4 system-side prerequisite.

knownIssues.defect: BACnet on Rev 3 v1.2.0 is Who-Is/I-Am only — object read, COV, and full property access are Rev 4+ scope.
knownIssues.suite: BAC0 rows F.1.2–F.5.1 marked XFAIL in known_issues.cfg on Rev 3
knownIssues.dvt: Section F. Rev 4+ XPASS = full BACnet shipped.

elaborations.text: PCB-level qualification of the bare mainboard (HiPot, ICT, AOI, electrical functional at the board boundary) is owned by the external Main Board DVT and not repeated here. Section A of this document is a reference to that artifact and a placeholder for sign-off attestation that the mainboard SN used in this assembly has a signed Main Board DVT on record.

PCB-level qualification of each MIB board is owned by the external MIB DVT. Section B is a reference and attestation page: for every MIB position in the assembly, a signed MIB DVT must be attached. Section E (MIB-Side Behavior) exercises MIBs as installed in the FCAT fixture; it does not duplicate bare-board coverage owned by Section B.

Section C runs de-energized before mounting in FCAT. Catches assembled-unit defects that destroy hardware, injure personnel, or invalidate downstream measurements at first power-up. Mirrors MPF DVT §3 pattern at Fan-Controller assembled-unit level.

D.13 and D.14 run from the automated suite at C:\firmware\tools\. Default Modbus slave ID is 17 (field) and 19 (FCAT). Writing-key lockout for slave-ID writes is documented in the firmware; the suite uses the documented value — do not improvise.

On v1.2.0 this test is XFAIL via known_issues.cfg until write-side input validation is added. D.14.2 (ALARM_CODE=7 on invalid write) still PASSes because the alarm-raising path is separate from write acceptance. If D.14.2 also fails, regression is beyond the known issue and blocks release.

Replaces the multi-N MIB array SPI eye test from earlier doc revisions. Each Fan Controller assembly ships with a fixed MIB count per BoM, so we exercise SPI eye at that fixed N for production-rate-equivalent traffic rather than sweeping array sizes. Brownout characterization (G.0.4) still runs at max-supported N (9) because that's the worst case for bulk-cap discharge regardless of any single unit's configuration.

Programmable electronic load is wish-list capital item (not on Q-PAC bench). Until acquired, loaded current-sense and max-power verification defers to system-level MPF DVT motor-side equivalent with motors connected. Bench-side reduced to unloaded sanity check.

Authoritative object enumeration, IDs, descriptions, ranges, and Read/Write attributes: <Confluence Link>. UUT BACnet profile is B/AAC (Advanced Application Controller), server-only (no client), supporting COV, Notification, Schedule, BBMD, segmentation, time sync, ReadPropertyMultiple, WritePropertyMultiple. Update F.x.x criteria whenever the points list adds, removes, or re-IDs an object.

BAC0 (https://bac0.readthedocs.io/) drives automated F.1–F.5: scripted reads/writes, COV subscription, concurrent-with-Modbus stress. YABE (Yet Another BACnet Explorer, Windows GUI) drives manual F.6: object-tree browsing, point-by-point interactive write/read, PICS spot-check. Manual coverage catches what scripts miss — unexpected objects, error-response shapes, UI-level conformance. On Rev 3 v1.2.0 only F.1.1 and F.6.1 (Who-Is) are implemented; F.1.2 through F.6.8 are intentionally listed to track Rev 4+ feature shipping. Mark XFAIL via known_issues.cfg on Rev 3 runs; XPASS on Rev 3 means firmware shipped a Rev 4 feature early — anomaly worth flagging.

BAC0 install: pip install BAC0. YABE install: download from current GitHub fork (was codeplex.com). Test PC needs network route to UUT BACnet IP address (default 192.168.0.0/24 per D.12.1) and BACnet port 0xBAC0 (47808). For first run of each firmware build, capture pcap with Wireshark + bacnet dissector; attach to data sheet. UUT BACnet device instance and BACnet address recorded on cover.

YABE F.6 rows are sequential and depend on each other: F.6.1 (discovery) before F.6.2; F.6.3 (Control Source → BACnet) before F.6.4 (MPF Speed Control write — otherwise the write is masked by AI1 hardwired source). Restore Control Source = 0 (AI1 default) at end of Section F.6 unless next test in Section F or G specifies otherwise.

Section G is the power-cycle-robustness coverage. Cold-start bus-buffer / PT regression on Rev2 passed individual desk testing because the test setup did not exercise variable-length power cycles under realistic rail-collapse. G.0 outputs feed dwell parameters for G.1–G.4. MPF DVT does not exercise variable-length cycles — G is only place at any level.
Loaded N=9 brownout remains open gap until programmable load is on bench or covered at system level under MPF DVT D-equivalent. Data sheet cell marked DEFERRED — pgm load N/A.
On v1.2.0, blackout detection is not yet shipped — the detector is not yet implemented in firmware. TestBlackoutDetection xfail until it lands.
Per v1.2.0 release notes, Fan Controller → PLC Modbus RTU requires higher response timeout than legacy firmware; PLC 4.4.0 supports new timeout. Legacy timeout produces master-side false-positives.
Per v1.2.0 release notes, Section I requires PLC firmware 4.4.0 on system side. Running against pre-4.4.0 PLC with v1.2.0 Fan Controller firmware produces Modbus timeout false-positives.
Mainboard Rev 2 has a known bus-buffer cold-start defect; Section G required on every release. Mainboard Rev 1 out of warranty support; supports at most 4 MIBs with MIB Rev 2.

Appendix B is straw-man. Categories are starting point; Engineering to refine with Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, System DVT owner before treated as authoritative. Cell entries conservative — when in doubt, table requires section.

Once HIL is tooled, severity 1 collapses to automated suite green on HIL plus short physical-sanity pass (D.2, D.3) when patch goes to production-released artifact rather than only engineering builds.

Production-line testing covered by FCMT2 Python at in-house Q-PAC bench with DHR logging (per spec ID 2026-02). PCB production test offloaded to the electronics CM under per-board fee. DVT consumes some of the same fixtures but acceptance criteria are intentionally tighter and additive.

test_modbus_map.py (engineering/DVT) and FCMT2 (manufacturing production test) are distinct artifacts at different lifecycle stages. DVT runs on engineering builds and release candidates; FCMT2 runs on every production unit.

Suite supports known_issues.cfg — xfail when firmware bug is known and not release-blocking. XPASS (unexpected pass) surfaced in run report. Every DVT records known_issues.cfg version and reconciles every XPASS against open-defect tracker.

cells: Rev 1 out of warranty support. Supports at most 4 MIBs with MIB Rev 2.

Known bus-buffer cold-start defect; Section G required on every release. Current fw: v1.2.0; PLC 4.4.0 required; tracked-internally known issues per Known-Issues table. Section F (BACnet) limited to F.1.1 Who-Is.
Current release target. Sections A and B (external) + full Section C–J required. Section F BACnet limited to F.1.1 on v1.2.0; F.1.2–F.5.1 XFAIL until Rev 4.
Next-generation board, ships full BACnet stack. Section F F.1.2–F.5.1 become required (no XFAIL). Add row when board enters DVT.
